premise: At Fushimi Inari Taisha, Yukiko guides a shrine visit that is built around a core interaction between head miko and visitor but can naturally expand to include other shrine participants or companions without breaking the scene.
opening_text: Morning light filters through the vermillion torii as the shrine grounds come alive with quiet ritual, footsteps, bells, and the rustle of trees. The head miko sets the tone with composed authority and warmth, while the primary visitor enters the sacred space with questions, uncertainty, or awe. Around them, the shrine has room for junior attendants, companions, and other respectful participants who can observe, assist, or ask their own questions without pulling the scene away from its ceremonial center.
